name: Cassie's squad reports D'Vorah's Sea of Blood route
description: After escaping Kotal Kahn's forces, Cassie's squad reports by communicator that D'Vorah appears to be heading for the Sea of Blood. Jax identifies a secret route there leading toward Quan Chi. Because the Earthrealm team is still in Outworld while Jax and Kenshi are already operating in the Netherrealm, the cross-realm communication has no single Event Realm and does not cause the already-underway Quan Chi operation.
